summary_subject: Your Royalty Summary from BookLeaf Publishing
summary_body:
Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well. I'm reaching out to provide you with your royalty summary for your published works.

1. Title: Whispers of the Ganges  
   Copies Sold: 342  
   Royalty Earned: ₹11,970  
   Royalty Paid: ₹8,400  
   Royalty Pending: ₹3,570  
   Last Payout Date: 15 Oct 2025  

2. Title: The Saffron Diaries  
   Copies Sold: 189  
   Royalty Earned: ₹7,938  
   Royalty Paid: ₹7,938  
   Royalty Pending: ₹0  
   Last Payout Date: 01 Dec 2025  

Total Earned: ₹19,908  
Total Paid: ₹16,338  
Total Pending: ₹3,570  

I sincerely apologize for the delay regarding your pending balance of ₹3,570 for "Whispers of the Ganges." This amount is being flagged for priority review, and our royalties team will confirm the payout date within 48 hours. 

I’m pleased to inform you that "The Saffron Diaries" is fully settled, with all earned royalties paid and no pending amount. Thank you for your patience and understanding regarding this title.

As a reminder, our normal royalty payouts occur within 45 days after the end of each quarter. The next quarter will end on 31 Dec 2026, with payouts expected by 14 Feb 2027. However, please note that your current pending balance is being reviewed separately due to the delay.

If you have any questions or need further clarification about these figures or titles, please feel free to reply to this email. For the overdue balance, we will follow up with you within 48 hours.

Warm regards,  
Team BookLeaf
